# one hour of PM2.5 at the sites (hour 0 = 2025-05-05T00:00:00Z)
points = sites %>%
  inner_join(by = "site_id", y = readings %>% filter(hour == 0))

grid = sites %>%
  st_make_grid(cellsize = c(5000, 5000), square = TRUE) %>%
  st_as_sf() %>% rename(geometry = x) %>%
  mutate(cell = 1:n())

cells = grid %>%
  st_join(points %>% select(site_id, value)) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  group_by(cell) %>%
  summarize(value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), n_sites = sum(!is.na(site_id)))

# Fill every cell from the site points: gstat::idw() with power idp = 2
surface = gstat::idw(value ~ 1, locations = points,
  newdata = st_centroid(grid), idp = 2, debug.level = 0)

# Leave-one-out: predict each site from all the others
loo = map_dfr(1:nrow(points), function(i) {
  fit = gstat::idw(value ~ 1, locations = points[-i, ], newdata = points[i, ],
    idp = 2, debug.level = 0)
  tibble(site_id = points$site_id[i], obs = points$value[i], pred = fit$var1.pred)
})
loo %>% summarize(rmse = sqrt(mean((pred - obs)^2)), mae = mean(abs(pred - obs)))
code.sql:
-- PostGIS: square grid over the site extent (metres, UTM 18N)
SELECT g.i, g.j, AVG(r.value) AS value, COUNT(s.site_id) AS n_sites
FROM ST_SquareGrid(5000, (SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_Extent(geom), 32618) FROM sites)) AS g
LEFT JOIN sites s ON ST_Intersects(g.geom, s.geom)
LEFT JOIN readings r ON r.site_id = s.site_id AND r.hour = 0
GROUP BY g.i, g.j;
